# netbird_agent_network_guardrail (Resource)

Manage Agent Network guardrails (model allowlists and prompt capture), see [NetBird Docs](https://docs.netbird.io/api/resources/agent-network) for more information.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbird_agent_network_guardrail" "strict" {
  name        = "Strict — Production"
  description = "Tight model allowlist with PII redaction."

  model_allowlist = {
    enabled = true
    models  = ["gpt-4o-mini", "claude-haiku-4-5"]
  }

  prompt_capture = {
    enabled    = true
    redact_pii = true
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `model_allowlist` (Attributes) Restrict which catalog models are allowed (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--model_allowlist))
- `name` (String) Display name for the guardrail
- `prompt_capture` (Attributes) Request/response prompt capture settings (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--prompt_capture))

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional human-readable description

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Guardrail ID

<a id="nestedatt--model_allowlist"></a>
### Nested Schema for `model_allowlist`

Required:

- `models` (List of String) Allowed catalog model IDs

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the model allowlist check is active


<a id="nestedatt--prompt_capture"></a>
### Nested Schema for `prompt_capture`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether prompt capture is enabled for this guardrail
- `redact_pii` (Boolean) Whether captured prompts have PII redacted
